resources.string: Reveal and enable the 3D wallpaper entry in the vivo theme app.
Forces five capability checks in the theme app to pass. The renderer (libThemeProcess.so + VAGPlayer) already ships inside the theme app, so nothing else is needed.

1. Enable this module in LSPosed and tick the "Theme" scope.
2. Turn on the switch above.
3. Force-stop the theme app, then open it again.
4. Go to lock-screen wallpaper editing — the 3D entry should now appear.

If the entry is still missing, check /storage/emulated/0/Android/media/com.mian.three/module.log for which check was bypassed.
Standalone module extracted from MianAssistant. Only unlocks the theme app\'s built-in 3D wallpaper capability; it does not add any renderer of its own.

The theme app pops up a warning when the clock covers too much of the subject. Enable to hide that dialog.
Bypasses the template-type thresholds (customSubType >= 1001/2001) and plugin-render checks, so flash card / decompress / grating / liquid style templates are no longer filtered out.
